subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be treated as expected shared-DM configuration behavior, a Telegram/session-routing bug, or a new semantic runaway-output guard requirement?
rationale: The source proves the shared-DM default and the diagnostics prove a Telegram send burst, but the payload-free report cannot distinguish config boundary, session contamination, duplicate/replay, provider behavior, or a missing semantic circuit breaker.

options.title: Keep as manual incident
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers ask for or gather enough redacted Telegram/runtime proof to choose the correct owner boundary.

options.title: Route to config guidance
options.body: Treat shared DMs without session.dmScope as supported behavior and improve doctor/docs/onboarding guidance rather than changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow fix
options.body: Define a product-owned change such as safer DM defaults, a route/session repair, or a runaway-output guard, then implement it with Telegram live proof.

recommendation.title: Keep as manual incident
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers ask for or gather enough redacted Telegram/runtime proof to choose the correct owner boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on the route/session default and product boundary documented in routing and security docs where this history points.
